author: The Sconi
title: Math Carnival scheduled for May 21 at Pleasant Prairie Elementary
text:
The Kenosha Unified School District announced on Apr. 28 that elementary students and their families are invited to attend the Math Carnival, which will take place on Thursday, May 21 from 5:30 to 7 p.m. at Pleasant Prairie Elementary, located at 9208 Wilmot Road.
The event aims to provide a night of family fun by combining hands-on math games with the atmosphere of a carnival. Organizers say the Math Carnival is open to all community members, not just those affiliated with the Kenosha Unified School District (KUSD). According to the announcement, “You do not need to be affiliated with KUSD to participate in family education programs – we welcome all members of our community!”
Families attending can expect interactive math activities as well as a shared meal during the evening. Community members who are not current KUSD students, families, or staff must join the Family Education Programs Community Group in order to register for this event. Once registered as group members, they will also receive information about future events without needing to rejoin.
For questions about registration or program details, individuals are encouraged to contact KUSD’s Community Relations Department at engage@kusd.edu or call 262-359-2256.
In related news about local schools, Indian Trail High School and Academy had the largest student enrollment among Kenosha County schools during the 2023-24 school year with a total of 2,001 students according to data from the Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction . This enrollment figure reflects a 1.1% increase compared with the previous year as reported by state records .
